assumptions.assumption: "Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes" means Bytes >= 10323804 (inclusive); tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded.
Media types with no tracks meeting the cutoff are excluded from the outer average. Each media type's average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios, using real (not integer) division.

alternatives.interpretation: Cutoff is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes.

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' means Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804 (minimum size threshold).

Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes / total milliseconds), computed with real division; the outer average is unweighted across media types that have at least one qualifying track.
